_comment: Signal-source configuration. Only operators edit this file; nothing auto-fetches (collection is always an explicit CLI action with --network). youtube_channels are public YouTube channel IDs (UC...). webreader.seeds are PUBLIC pages with durable URLs whose content feeds the SAME signal loop (see engine/web_extract.py); places.approved=true is an explicit operator record authorizing per-request Google Places billing — never set by code.

seeds.instructions: Extract recent changes to Marketplace enrollment rules, deadlines, or subsidy amounts. JSON: {topic, facts[], lang}.

places.budget_note: Set approved:true ONLY with the operator's explicit budget decision; per-request Google Places billing applies.

reddit_comments._note: COMMENT-depth discovery over the same public PullPush mirror: the actual question often sits in a replies, not the post record. Same author-dropping + taxonomy filter + review gates.

mastodon._note: PUBLIC Mastodon hashtag timelines (credential-free). Person-shaped Fediverse pledges; sparse but real. Edit tags freely.

bluesky._note: PUBLIC Bluesky post search via the anonymous public AppView (app.bsky.feed.searchPosts): no account, no key, quoted phrases + since=<date> recency at the source. Anonymous cursor paging is unreliable, so each query takes the freshest page only. queries support {"q": "...", "lang": "es"}.

lemmy._note: PUBLIC Lemmy anonymous COMMENT search (/api/v3/search type_=Comments sort=New): no account, no key. Add bigger instances (lemmy.ml, programming.dev) freely — pacing is per-call polite. Rate limits are per-instance operator config.

stackexchange._note: Public Stack Exchange API question search — no key needed at this volume; site param appends .stackexchange itself. money.SE is the verified COBRA/marketplace question pool (health.SE is clinical Q&A, not consumer coverage).

paid_social._note: LICENSED third-party collection services for platforms whose own public/API access this network cannot use (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook groups/PAGES, SERP-forum search). The code NEVER charges or activates anything: each service runs only when BOTH gates are open — paid_social.<service>.approved=true is an explicit operator budget record, and the service token exists in the environment (APIFY_TOKEN / BD_DATA_API_TOKEN). Missing either gate = refusal row + zero network.

instagram_comments.label: Instagram COMMENTS under posts found by the hashtag actor (second stage)

paste public page/group URLs into startUrls

input._operator_note: paste post URLs from the facebook_pages run first

input._operator_note: paste video URLs from the tiktok_hashtag run first

serp_forums.label: SERP search per forum/community results (compliant licensed search)

ollama._model_note:
url = the LOCAL Ollama API (never an external host). model='' means auto-pick:
the first INSTALLED model that answers a one-word test prompt. Set OLLAMA_MODEL env
or paste a name here (see `python tools/collect.py ai-health`) to pin one explicitly.

reddit_fallback._reason: both endpoints 403 from this datacenter IP; re-enable when the egress changes

public_profiles._doc: PUBLIC PROFILE CONTACT SURFACES (tools/public_contacts.py, engine/public_profiles.py). Collects the contact a person PUBLISHED ON THEIR OWN PUBLIC PROFILE (bio / custom fields) on the same credential-free public account that voiced a first-person coverage need. Public contact + public need evidence only; NEVER consent, never a lead, never contacted. Organisation-shaped profiles (agency/broker/llc...) are counted separately and never stored as consumer prospects. Pacing is per-call; a 401/403/429 stops that source for the run.
public_profiles._terms_note: Bluesky: public AppView (app.bsky.feed.searchPosts / app.bsky.actor.getProfile), anonymous. Mastodon: public tag timelines + /api/v1/accounts/<id> on the instance configured under mastodon.instance. Lemmy: anonymous /api/v3/search + /api/v3/user on lemmy.instances. All three are pages the platform itself serves to anonymous readers - no login, no key, no bypass. Re-check each platform's terms before increasing volume.
public_profiles._page_hops_note: ONE robots-checked hop to a page the account linked from its own bio, only when the bio itself carries no email/phone, capped at 10 per run. The contact is then labelled contact_origin=profile_link and its evidence names the linked page.

org_contacts._doc: ORGANIZATION public-contact discovery (tools/org_pipeline.py): sources where organizations VOLUNTARILY publish contact details for inquiries. Business contacts for outreach REVIEW only - never consumer leads, never contacted automatically. Seeds' robots terms are fetched and stored per run; a robots Disallow or a fetch error skips the seed and records the restriction.

partner-agency and client-services contacts published for public inquiries

discovery._doc: ACTIVE consumer discovery: permitted public pages read for individual people describing a health-coverage need. Intent, state and freshness are graded; a public thread where a reply is allowed is an engagement route even with no published contact. Nothing logs in, bypasses a wall, or contacts anyone.

discourse._note: public /search.json only; add a community you have checked robots/terms for

reddit_archive._note: Public Reddit archive API (arctic-shift), robots-allowed, credential-free. Two shapes: newest posts per board (firehose, low Florida density) and SUBREDDIT-SCOPED FULL-TEXT search (subreddit+query), which is what targets people this marketplace can serve. reddit.com's own RSS is NOT used: its robots.txt disallows /r/*/.rss even though the feed answers 200.

websearch._note: Provider-sanctioned search API only (set BING_SEARCH_KEY, or BRAVE_SEARCH_KEY, or GOOGLE_CSE_KEY+GOOGLE_CSE_CX). Each query pairs a consumer intent phrase with a contact token so the index returns pages where somebody published an address or number NEXT TO the ask. The adapter never reads a search engine's HTML results, never solves a captcha and never retries a 401/403/429.

stackexchange._note: Official /2.3 search API, no key at this volume; robots.txt allows /2.3. Questions only.

mastodon._note: Public tag timeline API, anonymous. Low yield expected; classifier filters.

identity._doc: IDENTITY RESOLUTION (engine/identity.py, tools/discovery.py enrich). For a consumer-intent prospect it reads the SAME public account's other public posts/comments (permitted archive API) plus the platform profile and, only when probes=true, a short allowlist of public profile surfaces keyed by the same handle. A name is stored only from explicit self-identification and only VERIFIED when two independent sources agree; a phone only when the same identity published it with ownership wording and is not a toll-free/business line. Publishing a number is never consent: marketing_eligibility stays BLOCKED_NO_CONSENT.
